None of them says either that the Mini's $35 furbo.com price shows up at checkout as $118.92 with a year of Furbo Nanny ($35 + $83.92).
standout_why: I opened vettedfur.com (cited), theconsumers.guide (cited), securitycameraforhome.com and thriftypaw.com. None mentions the Furbo Mini 360's 10-treat capacity. securitycameraforhome gives only the Furbo 360's '100 treats of about 0.4 inches' and Petcube's 1.5 lb. vettedfur and thriftypaw give no treat-size limits. theconsumers.guide gives TKENPRO 7–15 mm but no Petcube insert sizes. ChatGPT's own answers say only that 'some discounted versions require a Furbo Nanny subscription'. None gives the $118.92 checkout total. I couldn't open wired.com (the fetch tool can't reach it) or pawcog.com (certificate error), so I couldn't compare against them.
decides: This backs the Petcube Bites 2 Lite as the pick and drops the Furbo Mini 360 as a real treat dispenser for this question. The Mini 360 holds a tenth of the Furbo 360's treats, and its $35 headline price goes over $100 once the bundled first-year Nanny is added. The Bites 2 Lite holds 1.5 lb of treats, comes with three inserts for treats from under 12 mm to over 16 mm, and costs $99.99 at Petcube with no plan required. The TKENPRO 2K is still the rotating-camera option: theconsumers.guide lists it at $89.99 with a 0.5 L hopper for 7–15 mm treats.

findings.label: Treat capacity
findings.value: up to 10 small treats ('Lite Treat Toss')
findings.note: This is Furbo's own side-by-side comparison. The same page lists the Furbo 360 at 100 treats, so the Mini holds a tenth as many. It gives no treat dimension for the Mini, only 'small treats'.

findings.label: Video and zoom
findings.note: The same page lists the Furbo 360 at 1080p FHD with 4× digital zoom.

findings.label: Treat capacity
findings.note: Stated as a piece count, not a weight, so it can't be compared directly with Petcube's 1.5 lb.

findings.label: Treat size
findings.value: about 0.4 in (about 10 mm) treats, 100 of them
findings.source_title: Best Pet Camera with Treat Dispenser 2026: Furbo vs Petcube (securitycameraforhome.com)
findings.note: securitycameraforhome writes 'Furbo rates the Furbo 360 at 100 treats of about 0.4 inches.' The 0.4 in figure comes from the reviewer, not from a Furbo page I opened. 0.4 in × 25.4 = 10.2 mm.

findings.label: furbo.com price vs checkout total
findings.value: $35 device (was $99); the Yearly option adds to cart at $118.92 including Furbo Nanny Standard billed at $83.92 (average $6.99/mo)
findings.note: $35 + $83.92 = $118.92. Both visible purchase paths (Standard plan, Yearly plan) include a Nanny plan. The page also has an 'Expand to see more plans' control, and I couldn't see a device-only option. The Shopify JSON was blocked (HTTP 403), so I couldn't check the variants.

findings.label: Plan requirement
findings.value: includes a Furbo Nanny plan that must be activated during setup; basic features remain after cancelling
findings.source_title: How to Setup and Activate Camera Subscription Required (Furbo Help Center)
findings.note: The article covers Subscription Required Furbos bought from Amazon. It quotes: 'Even after canceling, you'll still have access to the basic features.' It doesn't give the minimum term.

findings.label: Treat capacity
findings.note: Stated as a weight, with no piece count. The container is detachable and dishwasher safe up to 130°F (petcube.com/bites-2-lite).

findings.label: Treat size inserts
findings.value: Small < 12 mm (0.47 in); Medium 12–16 mm (0.47–0.63 in); Large > 16 mm (0.63 in)
findings.note: Three inserts come in the box. Petcube's Bites 2 treat article gives an overall range of 0.3–1 in (https://petcube.com/support/article/bites2-treat-recommendations), but that article doesn't name the Lite.

findings.label: Price and plan
findings.value: $99.99 (list $149.99); works out of the box with no plan; Petcube Care $9.99/mo adds video storage and smart alerts
findings.note: petcube.com/bites-2-lite shows the same $99.99 and says Care bundles start from $5.99/mo. vettedfur lists $79.99 as of Nov 13, 2026.

findings.label: Field of view

findings.label: Treat hopper, treat size, pan, price
